# Navgrow Engineering Service Pvt. Ltd.

> DPIIT-recognised, MSME-registered engineering and sustainability company based in Siliguri, West Bengal, India (CIN: U74999WB2022PTC256012). Navgrow delivers railway infrastructure, industrial engineering, civil construction, government contracts, and sustainability solutions (solar, rainwater harvesting, wastewater treatment, energy efficiency, and green-building consulting) for industry, government, and infrastructure clients.

Navgrow combines engineering excellence with modern technology to deliver reliable, quality-first, compliance-ready solutions. The company works to Indian Railways and departmental vendor norms, executes government tenders via GeM and IREPS, and provides end-to-end delivery from design through supervised execution to a full handover dossier.

## Services

- Railway Infrastructure: Track, ROB, electrification, signalling, and shed works to RDSO standards
- Industrial Engineering: Fabrication, plant engineering, and installations for manufacturers
- Civil & Construction: Buildings, bridges, roads, and structural works
- Government Contracts: Tender-based execution via GeM and IREPS with full documentation
- Maintenance & AMC: Preventive and corrective upkeep that maximises asset uptime
- Solar Energy Solutions: Rooftop and ground-mount solar
- Rainwater Harvesting: Catchment, recharge, and storage systems
- Wastewater Treatment & Recycling: STP/ETP, reuse, and zero-liquid-discharge systems
- Energy Efficiency & Audits: Audits and retrofits that cut energy cost and carbon
- Green Building & Sustainability: Consulting for efficient, certified, low-impact buildings
